from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from a single company's filing for the specified period."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company as it appears in the filing")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    
    # Numerator: Year-over-year change in consolidated net income
    net_income_current_label: str = Field(description="The line item label for the current period consolidated net income")
    net_income_current_amount: str = Field(description="The amount string including unit (e.g., '$8.7 million' or '$78,663 thousand')")
    
    net_income_prior_label: str = Field(description="The line item label for the prior period consolidated net income")
    net_income_prior_amount: str = Field(description="The amount string including unit (e.g., '$168.0 million')")
    
    # Denominator: Total Assets
    assets_label: str = Field(description="The line item label for total assets")
    assets_amount: str = Field(description="The amount string including unit (e.g., '$11,480.8 million')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData] = Field(description="List of all companies found with their financial metrics")
